Many schools let students to use cell phones in the classroom for educational purposes.
Some people believe that students should not use any electronic device thinking about the effects and consequences of allowing students to have cell phones in classroom.
I believe students can have and use cell phones during class because it is important for information and dictionary.
In many opportunities, teachers require students to use their phone and search for information.
Information is vital in some classes to complete assignments given from the teacher.
For example, history teachers allow students to use the phone during class and look for information to complete projects assign in.
Let students to find information in class is one of the best ways of learning in the school.
Also, students who come from different countries use the cell phone as a dictionary during class.
Students from ESOL class, English for Speakers of other Languages, use the phone to look for a word in Google translate.
For some of the ESOL students, using the phone in class as a dictionary is the faster way to learn English.
Use the cell phone as a dictionary in the classroom is a good tool of learning for students with a second native language.
In conclusion, allowing students to have and use the cell phone in classroom is a good idea of learning for educational purposes.

5.Overall: Native-like facility in the use of language with syntactic variety, Appropriate word choice and phrases; well-controlled text organization; precise use of grammar and conventions; rare language inaccuracies that do not impede communication.

5.Conventions: Consistent use of appropriate conventions to convey meaning; spelling, capitalization, and punctuation errors nonexistent or negligible.
